summary: Iteration 2 tests all pass. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests green in 109s covering event persistence to Mongo, cold-session rehydration, streaming planner (TokenStreamed events), memory endpoints (/memory, /memory/recall), MemoryArchive after run-all, MemoryHit on overlapping sessions, and /research /verify /skill /run-all now succeeding on sessions that exist only in Mongo (previously 404). Frontend: Landing page kinetic upgrade verified (scramble text finalized to 'EVENT-DRIVEN · LOOP-DRIVEN · COGNITION-DRIVEN', marquee loops present, animated counters 26/8/12/0, shimmer gradient on goal container, rotating dashed circle beside 'in loops.'). Runtime dock magnification confirmed (icon under cursor grows from 46→78.8px, neighbor at 59.8px). Model switcher label updates immediately and toast fires. Event stream renders 206 TokenStreamed events for a persisted session — proves cold rehydration also drives UI.

ui_bugs.issue: The 2s polling in Runtime.jsx (fetch on interval → setSession) overwrites the optimistic local model update. Result: user picks 'Qwen3 80B' → label flashes to it, toast fires, but within ~2s the label reverts to whatever the backend session record says (still 'openrouter/free' because /sessions/{sid} has no PATCH endpoint). Screenshot confirms revert to 'Auto (Free Router)'. Fix options: (1) add PATCH /api/sessions/{sid} to persist model on server, (2) hold the local model override in a separate state that survives polling, or (3) stop polling once the initial session is loaded and rely purely on WS events.

action_items: Persist model selection server-side (PATCH /api/sessions/{sid}) or otherwise prevent the periodic getSession poll from clobbering the just-selected model. Current UX: label reverts within 2s of selection.
critical_code_review_comments: runtime.py:243 — MemoryHit events emit BEFORE PlannerThinking; iteration 2 correctly separates recall from streaming path. Streaming fallback (line 279-298) is robust: if SSE fails it falls to chat_json, and if that fails a static fallback plan is used — good defensive layering.

eventbus.py:79 — rehydrate loads up to _max_buffer (1200) events sorted by seq. Correct. However, hydration only fires when in-memory buffer is empty; if a session had 3 events buffered and Mongo has 500, /events returns only 3. Consider comparing counts, or always call rehydrate when the buffer size < Mongo count.
memory.py:66 — recall pulls up to 500 memory docs into memory then scores in Python. Fine for MVP but O(n) per call; will not scale past a few thousand items. Add a text index or embeddings later.

server.py:132-163 — all four action endpoints (/plan /research /verify /skill) now correctly use `runtime.get(sid) or await runtime.load_session(sid)` — fixes iteration 1 gap. Verified via TestPersistedSessionActions.
Runtime.jsx:32 — polling getSession every ~2s is what causes the model switcher revert. Either stop polling after initial load or make the poll merge-not-overwrite for locally-mutated fields.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all critical iteration 2 flows work; 1 medium UX bug (model switcher revert)

test_credentials: No auth. OPENROUTER_API_KEY already in backend/.env.
